g.text: Observed outgoing profiles across 816 development types
One male specimen | Complete descriptive tables | All 11,771 partner bins retained
84,735 neurons: 84,609 positive-mass profiles; 126 zero-mass neurons counted but excluded from composition.
In-sample summaries: each neuron contributes to its own type-side centroid. Dispersion depends on support; unknown partner mass stays in every denominator.
No population inference, subtype test, held-out prediction or bilateral reproducibility claim. The provider taxonomy is connectivity-informed.
